Container.Name: VoidPort
Container.Overview: VoidPort makes a server on your Unraid box reachable from the internet without port forwarding, also behind CGNAT: game servers (Minecraft, Valheim, ...), web apps, Home Assistant, anything TCP or UDP. Players connect to a public address like nbg1.voidport.net:30123.[br][br] Create a tunnel at voidport.app/dashboard (a subscription is needed), paste its token and enter where your server listens. The container only connects out to the relay; it publishes no ports.[br][br] Optional: HTTPS on your own domain with an automatic Let's Encrypt certificate.
Container.Requires: A VoidPort subscription and a tunnel created at voidport.app/dashboard.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: tunnel port-forwarding cgnat minecraft game-server playit ngrok

Config.Name: Tunnel token
Config.Description: Token of your tunnel from voidport.app/dashboard. Several tokens separated by commas run together (e.g. game + voice chat).

Config.Name: Target host
Config.Description: Where your server listens: the LAN IP of this Unraid server (e.g. 192.168.1.10) if its port is published or it uses host networking, or the container name if VoidPort and the server share a custom Docker network (Network Type: that network).

Config.Name: Local port
Config.Description: Optional. The port your server listens on at the target host, if it differs from the local port saved with the tunnel (e.g. a container port published as 8081). Leave empty to use the tunnel's port. Only with a single token.
